title: Winter World
description: The vanilla Minecraft experience, enhanced with mods that make winter survival brutal, immersive, and more exciting.
body:
❄️ WINTER SURVIVAL MODPACK

A vanilla+ winter survival experience where the world is frozen, resources are limited, and survival is no longer easy.

This modpack is designed to feel like Minecraft, but harsher and more immersive, adding the challenge of cold weather, seasonal survival, improved exploration, and a stronger sense of progression.

🔥 Survive the freezing cold 🌨️ Explore snowy landscapes and abandoned ruins 🏕️ Build shelter, create warmth, and secure food 🏘️ Rebuild civilization with your friends ⚙️ Optimizeble for multiplayer servers

Perfect for players who want a realistic survival challenge without losing the classic Minecraft feel.
